property_summary: For any caller, if wager() succeeds (does not revert), then it must be that msg.sender == tx.origin; the buggy modifier allows a contract to call wager() and bypass this check, breaking the invariant that only externally owned accounts can successfully wager.
change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.sender == tx.origin)' with 'require(true)' so that contracts can call wager and potentially bypass onlyRealPeople, changing wagers mapping for an EOA using a contract wallet.
